description: Search the NPPES NPI registry for individual practitioners and healthcare organizations by name, organization name, location, provider type, and specialty. Plain-language specialty terms (e.g. "cardiologist", "pediatric cardiologist") resolve through the bundled NUCC taxonomy; the top match's search text becomes taxonomy_description, and all resolved candidates are returned in metadata. taxonomy_description also takes a NUCC code, such as one npi_get_provider returns, and searches with that code's text. Location belongs in the dedicated city/state/postal_code inputs, not inside specialty. Each provider row includes the NPI, name, primary specialty, city/state/ZIP, type, and active/deactivated status; the NPI is the input for npi_get_provider when the full record is needed. With name_role "authorized_official", first_name, last_name, and name_search match each organization's authorized official instead of the provider, the search covers organizations only, and each row names the official in authorizedOfficial. At least one search criterion is required, and the registry rejects state-only searches. When city/state/postal_code are given, only practice addresses are searched, never mailing addresses: a provider is returned only when its primary practice location or one of its other practice locations matches all of them. A provider kept on another practice location names it in matchedLocation. A specialty filter matches any of a provider's taxonomies, as a case-insensitive prefix of the taxonomy's classification or specialization; text from a resolved specialty or a decoded code returns only rows holding a code in resolvedTaxonomies (a classification-level code counts its whole classification, and a code newer than the bundled NUCC set counts only toward a classification-level code of its classification), and a row matched through a taxonomy other than its primary names it in matchedTaxonomy. Name searches also match former and other names, sorted by current name; such a row names the matching name in matchedOtherName. The registry never reports a true match total, and one search reaches only its first 1200 matches: a full page names the next in nextPage, and the terminal window (skip 1000, limit 200) returns continuationPostalCodes, the postal_code values that continue the search.

city.description: Practice-location city, case-insensitive. A trailing "*" after at least 2 characters matches every city starting with them (e.g. "SAN F*").

first_name.description: Individual first name, or the authorized official's under name_role "authorized_official". Trailing wildcard "*" allowed with at least 2 leading characters.

last_name.description: Individual last name, or the authorized official's under name_role "authorized_official". Trailing wildcard "*" allowed with at least 2 leading characters.

limit.description: Maximum providers to return (default 10). Values above 200 are clamped to the registry cap of 200 with a notice.

name_role.description: Whose name first_name, last_name and name_search match: the provider's own (default) or an organization's authorized official. authorized_official searches organizations only and needs a first or last name.

name_search.description: One person's name: the provider's, or the authorized official's under name_role "authorized_official". The first token becomes first_name and the last token becomes last_name; use first_name/last_name when middle names or multi-part surnames matter.

organization_name.description: Organization name (implies provider_type organization; combines with first_name, last_name, or name_search only under name_role "authorized_official"). Trailing wildcard "*" allowed with at least 2 leading characters.

postal_code.description: Practice-location postal code: a 5-digit ZIP (also matching the ZIP+4 codes that extend it), a 9-digit ZIP+4 (ddddd-dddd accepted), or a 2–9 digit prefix with one trailing "*" (e.g. "98*", "981*"). Any other 2–4 or 6–8 digit string is matched exactly, as a non-US postcode is: "981" finds only an address recorded as exactly 981, and "981*" is the ZIP prefix. A ZIP+4 prefix (6+ digits) never matches a practice address recorded with only a 5-digit ZIP. A lettered postal code (Canadian, UK) matches only some providers recorded with it; search those by city. A blank value is treated as omitted.

provider_type.description: Restrict to individuals (NPI-1) or organizations (NPI-2). Omit to search both; when set, it must match the name fields ("individual" for first_name/last_name/name_search, "organization" for organization_name or name_role "authorized_official").

skip.description: Results to skip for pagination (0–1000). A full page names the next in nextPage.

specialty.description: Plain-language specialty (e.g. "pediatric cardiologist"), resolved through the bundled NUCC taxonomy to exact descriptions before searching. Codes NUCC marks inactive are never resolved. The resolved taxonomies are echoed in resolvedTaxonomies, and only rows holding one of their codes (a classification-level code counting every code of its classification) are returned, since the text sent also matches other codes that start with it (e.g. Family Medicine for "family nurse practitioner"). A code newer than the bundled NUCC set counts only toward a classification-level code of its classification, as resolvedTaxonomies describes. Mutually exclusive with taxonomy_description.

state.description: 2-letter state code (e.g. "WA"). The registry rejects state-only searches, so another criterion is required. A blank value is treated as omitted.

taxonomy_description.description: A NUCC taxonomy code in any case (e.g. "207RC0000X", as npi_get_provider returns it) or taxonomy text. A code searches with that code's text, named in resolvedTaxonomies, and so does a NUCC display name such as "Cardiovascular Disease Physician" unless it is itself the start of a NUCC classification or specialization (e.g. "Critical Access Hospital"); a code the bundled NUCC set lacks or marks inactive is rejected before searching. Other text goes to the registry as written. The registry matches the text sent as a case-insensitive prefix of each taxonomy's classification or specialization, so a classification code (e.g. "207R00000X", Internal Medicine) also reaches its specializations. A decoded code or display name returns only rows holding that code, or for a classification code any code of its classification (a code newer than the bundled NUCC set included, as resolvedTaxonomies describes), since the text also reaches other codes that start with it; text sent as written is never filtered. Mutually exclusive with specialty.

use_first_name_alias.description: Include first-name variants (default true upstream). False requests exact first-name matching. Applies to the resolved first_name, including name_search and an authorized official's first name, only without a wildcard; other-name matching remains enabled.

name: npi_search_providers

appliedFirstNameAlias.description: Effective first-name alias expansion for a resolved non-wildcard first name, including the upstream default true. Absent when no first name exists or it contains a wildcard.

appliedTaxonomyDescription.description: The taxonomy_description text sent to the registry as the specialty filter: the first resolvedTaxonomies description, else the caller's taxonomy_description, trimmed.

continuationPostalCodes.description: Present only at the terminal window (a full page at skip 1000, limit 200): postal_code values that continue the same search, each re-run from skip 0 with the same arguments — the notice gives the full procedure. Splitting a 2–4 or 6–8 digit prefix lists the prefix's digits without "*" first, which match only a postal code recorded with exactly those digits, then its ten one-digit-longer prefixes. Empty when no postal split remains (postal_code is already a 5-digit ZIP, a full ZIP+4, an exact 2–4 or 6–8 digit value, or not a numeric ZIP prefix).

items.description: A postal_code to re-run with: a trailing-"*" prefix, or the digits of the prefix being split without "*".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_search_criteria`: No effective search criterion was provided. `conflicting_specialty`: Both specialty and taxonomy_description were supplied. `mixed_provider_criteria`: Individual criteria (first_name, last_name, name_search) were combined with organization criteria (organization_name), directly or through provider_type. Under name_role "authorized_official" the name fields and name_role are organization criteria. `official_name_required`: name_role "authorized_official" was given without a first_name, last_name, or name_search to match the official by. `unresolved_specialty`: The specialty term matched no active NUCC taxonomy (the message names any inactive codes it matched), or was made only of generic words ("doctor", "M.D.", "specialist") that name no specialty; or taxonomy_description was a NUCC code the bundled set lacks or NUCC marks inactive (the message names an inactive code's replacement). No search is sent. `invalid_search_field`: The registry returned a field error (e.g. wildcard under 2 characters, a postal_code with a space or the wrong number of digits, bad provider type). A postal_code error carries its own recovery naming the accepted forms. `unmatched_taxonomy_description`: The registry found no taxonomy for the description sent (its error 14): taxonomy_description, or the text a specialty resolved to, starts no classification or specialization in the registry's wording. The combined "Classification, Specialization" text never matches. When the text sent is the search text of a bundled NUCC code, the error carries its own recovery naming the broader classification to search, or a related one to browse for. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextPage.description: The next page: re-run the same arguments with this skip and limit. Present after a full page while rows remain reachable. When skip + limit passes 1000 it is skip 1000, limit 200, whose leading rows repeat rows already returned (the notice says how many) — dedupe by NPI.

limit.description: The limit to send for the next page.

skip.description: The skip to send for the next page.

notice.description: Guidance — the page-size-not-total caveat, the next page or terminal-window continuation procedure, other-name, matched-taxonomy, location-filter, and resolved-code-filter counts, a lettered postal_code's partial matching, or how to broaden an empty result (for an exactly matched partial ZIP, its trailing-"*" form).

items.description: A compact provider row for disambiguation.

authorizedOfficial.description: The organization's authorized official, whose name a name_role "authorized_official" search matched. Present only on the rows of such a search, when the registry records a first or last name for the official.

name.description: The official's name as "First Middle Last", leaving out parts the registry does not record. Prefix, suffix, credential, and telephone are on the npi_get_provider record.

title.description: The official's title or position, when recorded.

matchedLocation.description: The additional practice location that satisfied the requested city/state/postal_code. Present only when the primary practice location is elsewhere.

city.description: City of the matching practice location.

postalCode.description: Postal/ZIP code of the matching practice location.

state.description: State of the matching practice location.

matchedOtherName.description: The other (former, professional, DBA, or alternate) name this row matched the name search through. Present only when the current name fails a requested last_name, organization_name, or wildcard first_name and this other name satisfies it (case-insensitive, ignoring punctuation and spaces, trailing "*" as a prefix). An exact first_name alone never marks a row: the registry also matches first-name variants (Bob for Robert). Under name_role "authorized_official" only organization_name can mark a row, since the official's name is matched against the official alone.

name.description: The other name as "First Middle Last", or its organization name.

type.description: Registry name type, e.g. "Former Name", "Professional Name".

matchedTaxonomy.description: The taxonomy this row matched the specialty filter through, present only when primaryTaxonomy does not match and another taxonomy does. When the search resolved taxonomies (resolvedTaxonomies), it is the first of the row's taxonomies holding a resolved code, a classification-level code counting every code of its classification, including a code newer than the bundled NUCC set as resolvedTaxonomies describes. When taxonomy_description was sent as written, it is the first whose classification or specialization starts with appliedTaxonomyDescription (case-insensitive, in the registry's wording), as the registry matches.

description.description: Description as the registry serves it ("Classification" or "Classification, Specialization"). When the registry serves none, the bundled NUCC text in the same form, marked by descriptionSource. Absent when neither has one.

descriptionSource.description: "nucc" when the registry served no description for this code and description comes from the bundled NUCC code set. Absent when the registry supplied it.

npi.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier — the chaining key for npi_get_provider.

postalCode.description: Primary practice-location postal/ZIP code when present.

primaryTaxonomy.description: The provider's primary taxonomy (the entry flagged primary, else the first listed).

description.description: Description as the registry serves it ("Classification" or "Classification, Specialization"). When the registry serves none, the bundled NUCC text in the same form, marked by descriptionSource. Absent when neither has one.

descriptionSource.description: "nucc" when the registry served no description for this code and description comes from the bundled NUCC code set. Absent when the registry supplied it.

status.description: Registry status — never treat a deactivated NPI as current.

resolvedTaxonomies.description: The taxonomies the search resolved: for a specialty term, the top five ranked candidates plus every later one that sends the first one's text at its level (specialization or classification); for a taxonomy_description code or display name, the one code it decoded to. The first supplies appliedTaxonomyDescription; pass another candidate's code as taxonomy_description to search it instead. Only rows holding one of these codes are returned, a classification-level code counting every code of its classification. A code newer than the bundled NUCC set counts only when its description is the classification of a classification-level code among these, alone or followed by ", " and a specialization, and its first four characters are those of a code that counts; with no classification-level code among these, no new code counts. Absent when taxonomy_description was sent as written.

description.description: The text that searches the registry for this code: its specialization, else its classification, in the registry's wording where that differs from NUCC's.

truncated.description: True when the NPPES page contained at least cap providers before the location and resolved-code filters ran; more may match even when shown is below cap, or 0.

title: Npi Search Providers
